segment one.title: "upay", a fast growing mobile financial provider, recently held its first Annual General Meeting (AGM)
segment one.title bn: "upay", a fast growing mobile financial provider, recently held its first Annual General Meeting (AGM)
segment one.desc:
The first Annual General Meeting (AGM) of upay, a fast growing mobile financial provider in the country was held today (July 29, 2021). upay is the MFS brand of UCB Fintech Limited, a subsidiary of United Commercial Bank Limited.

Mr. Anisuzzaman Chowdhury, Chairman of the Board of Directors of UCB Fintech Company Limited chaired the AGM held at the Head Office of UCB Fintech Limited.

Members of the Board of Directors, Mr. Mohammed Shawkat Jamil, Mr. Bashir Ahmed, Mr. ATM Tahmiduzzaman, Independent Director Mr. Ashraf Bin Taj, and Managing Director of UCB Fintech Company Limited Mr. Sydul H Khandaker along with senior officials of upay were also present at the AGM. 

UCB Fintech Limited was established on July 30, 2020 as a subsidiary of the United Commercial Bank to provide mobile financial services to the common people of Bangladesh.

The company launched its commercial operation on March 17, 2021.
